subject: [PATCH] KVM: arm64: Top up the mmu memcache on user fault for NV

reviews.author: Lorenzo (ARM)
reviews.summary: Reviewer noted that the patch may still be necessary even for narrow conditions like exec permission faults on THP blocks, as the VMM can replace memory and trigger a fault, leading to a potential allocation outside NV.

2026-11-27.patch_summary: This patch modifies the KVM (Kernel-based Virtual Machine) for arm64 to top up the mmu memcache on user faults, specifically when a permission fault occurs in a non-volatile memory (NV) region. The current implementation does not handle this scenario correctly, leading to potential issues with memory allocation. To address this, the patch adds a condition to top up the mmu memcache for every user fault, which covers the narrow case of a permission fault on a THP block. This change is necessary because the existing logic has limitations and conflicts with older kernel versions.
